start.text:
You.
I thought better of you. I trusted you!
How could you- why would you do this?

node.text: {{R|ANSWER ME.}}

start.text: I know what you did. Get away from me.

choice.text: I have your static. Take it.

node.choice: May I use the rock tumbler?
Remind me what you want me to find for you again?
Cat said that you two don't get along. What's the story there?

start.text: =name=! How lovely to see you. What can I do for you?
start.choice: You mentioned that you could help me learn item mods?
Do you get along with Cat these days?

start.text: {{emote|*Bright shies away from the light.*}} Ow, ow. Not so bright. What is it?
How can I help you, wanderer? Parts? Or do you need something fixed?
start.choice: You keep your workshop very dark. Why is that?

conversation.node: I understand. Let me know if you change your mind.

node.text: I am? {{emote|*Bright thinks.*}} I am, I suppose. Interesting.
I am, yes. I was not always, but I am now, and it's only worsened with time. There is a reason I keep my workshop dark. Please be mindful, if it isn't too much to ask.
I am sensitive to light. I was not always, but I am now, and it's only worsened over time. I would be grateful if you continue to cover your lights when you enter.
You may. Just make sure you clean up. We keep it busy and we are not liable for any missing gems if you leave them there.

node.choice: Maybe. What did you have in mind?

node.text: So, as you may have noticed, I have problems with light. I'm looking to fix that, and I need someone else to help me.
Just a simple trade. The ichor merchants tell of a rare fluid that will be of use to me. Very entropic. I believe that it will be of use to me. If you can get me a dram of it, I could test my theory.
node.choice: What kind of liquid am I looking for?

node.text: Warm static. Not dilute; I'll need it in pure form. Just a dram should be enough. I'll compensate you for your work.
node.choice: Alright. I'll track down your static. Where should I start looking?
How will this help your problems with light?
I don't like the feeling of this. I'll pass, I'm afraid.

node.text: I'd prefer not go into detail on that just yet. Just rest assured that it won't cause any harm to anyone.
I happen to specialize in item modding. If you're a tinker yourself, I'd be more than happy to help you learn a few mods; anything you have in mind, I can probably teach you.

Wonderful! {{emote|*=pronouns.Possessive= hands clasp together.*}} Thank you kindly. I will eagerly anticipate your return. And when you do find the static, DO NOT do anything else with it. Bring it directly back to me. Okay?
node.choice: Where can I find warm static?
While I'm here, I had other questions.
I guess I'd better start looking. Live and drink.

node.text:
Warm static originates from the Moon Stair, but that's likely not a place you want to visit. The alchemist in Bethesda Susa is an expert in all things liquid, and may help; the liquid-tinkers in the Stiltgrounds may be of use to you, too, though I'd expect no consistent results.
I would only visit the Stair had I no other option. You would be looking for a certain type of jell. Liquid of the purity I seek can be harvested from them, but you may need to kill several of them to find an appropriate sample -- and keep them intact when you do. No fire, no lasers.
And be cautious. Cat has told me stories.

A highly entropic liquid, called warm static. I believe it may be able to help me tolerate the light again. It originates from the Moon Stair, and if you have no other options, I believe you could source it from a certain type of ooze there. A much safer idea would be to find the alchemist in Bethesda Susa, or an ichor merchant elsewhere. I only need a dram, but it needs to be pure; if it's dilute or otherwise contaminated, it won't work for my purposes.

{{emote|*Bright convulses on the floor. =pronouns.Possessive= arms warp and twist as though seen through dirty glass before two of them disappear outright in a flurry of hissing snow. =pronouns.Possessive= skin flickers, darkens, and flickers again. There is crackling, and something else -- a thin keening like to a wounded animal, alone in the flats, heard distantly on a cold wind.*}}
{{emote|*And then it stops. Eddies of static flicker about the tinker's body as =pronouns.possessive= skin shudders unsteadily with a warm glow as =pronouns.subjective= =verb:sit:afterponoun= up.*}}

{{emote|*Bright is staring with a foolish grin.*}}
It worked? It worked, I believe. My eyes don't hurt, my skin doesn't prickle, I...
=name=, words cannot describe what you have done for me. You have done me a favor I can never repay. Whenever you're ready, I can teach you some of my designs, as I promised. I can only hope that will be enough.
Thank you.

choice.text: You're welcome. Live and drink, Bright.

node.text:
Much better, thanks to you! I seem to have mostly lost my sense of pain, which is both a good and bad thing given my occupation. I also miss my arms, but I'm acclimating.
More than anything, though, I'm just so glad to be able to go outside again. I've missed it so badly.
node.choice: I'm glad to hear. Live and drink.

node.text: That's rather personal, I'm afraid.

Cat and I used to... well. We were very close. She became much harder to talk to when she took on the mantle of warden. Eventually we stopped speaking. With how miserable I'd become in the light, I rarely ever interacted with her. I suppose some resentment was to be expected.
But now that I can go outside again, I see her much more. And I think things have been going rather well.
node.choice: You have my well-wishes. Live and drink.

node.text: That is correct. Would you like to learn now? You need not know the requisite skills -- anything I teach you may be put into practice even if you only know the basics of tinkering.
node.choice: Perhaps not yet. Live and drink.
